title: Regular Sublattices, O Closed Ideals and Dedekind MacNeille Completions
summary: We study regular sublattices of lattices that satisfy the Join-Infinite Distributive Law (JID) under Dedekind MacNeille completion. Using order convergence, we identify the lattice of O-closed ideals with Crawleys completion, and compare it with the Dedekind MacNeille completion. When DM(L) satisfies (JID), this comparison yields extension results for lattice homomorphisms. In particular, if Y is a regular sublattice of a complete lattice L, and L and DM(Y) satisfy (JID), then the canonical extension lattice-embeds DM(Y) into L with join-regular image.
